steps.title: Goal
steps.content: Help the farmer harvest more crops using less blocks! Use loops to harvest 4 crops using only 6 blocks.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.content: Add a repeat block, and use it to repeat the 'Water' and 'Next Day' blocks 2 times.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.content: From the {Farm}[category-farm] category, add a {water row (1) column (1)}[block-water] block and place it inside the {repeat (10) times}[block-loops] block.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.content: From the {Farm}[category-farm] category, add a {next day}[block-next-day] block and place it inside the {repeat (10) times}[block-loops] block, and under the {water row (1) column (1)}[block-water]  block.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.content: Since we only need 2 days to pass before harvesting a crop, inside the {repeat (10) times}[block-loops] block, change the 10 to a 2, so the block reads {repeat (2) times}[block-loops].

steps.title: Step 5
steps.content:
“From the {Farm}[category-farm] category, add a {harvest row (1) column (1)} [block-harvest] block and place it below all other blocks inside the {begin}[block-begin] block. 
Press the {Run All Days}[button-run-all-days] button. Check that 1 crop has been harvested.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.content:
Now we are going to add another repeat block, so we harvest 4 crops instead of 1.  

From the {Loops}[category-loops] category in the Toolbox, add a {repeat (10) times}[block-loops] block at the top of the stack inside the {begin}[block-begin] block.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.content:
Move all blocks in the stack to inside the {repeat (10) times}[block-loops] block, keeping them in the same order. 
Next, inside the first {repeat (10) times}[block-loops] block, change the 10 to a 4, so the block reads {repeat (4) times}[block-loops].

steps.title: Step 8
steps.content: Press the {Run All Days}[button-run-all-days] button. Have 4 crop been harvested? Great job!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.content: Go further: Can you change the code so 6 crops are harvested instead? Can you do this by changing only one number? How else can you customize this code?
